endpoints.label: Build, sign and publish a new version (.utpkg)
endpoints.description: Exports every artifact with secrets removed (each credential becomes a requirement), adds data rows for tables in "rows" mode, signs with the instance key and stores the version. `usertasks packages build -o file.utpkg` builds and downloads in one step. Requires packages.manage.

params.name: version
params.description: Semantic version; default: the latest version bumped by `bump`, or 1.0.0

params.name: dependencies
params.description: Packages that must be installed first, e.g. [{ "package_slug": "vendor-master", "version_range": "^1.0.0" }]

endpoints.description: Download a built version as a .utpkg file (base64 in JSON) Requires packages.view.

endpoints.description: The package library: installed packages with version, source and status Requires packages.view.

endpoints.label: Dry run: verify a package and show what installing or upgrading it would do
endpoints.description: Per asset create / update / unchanged with field diffs (upgrade in place: assets map onto their earlier install), locally modified assets, assets removed in this version (never deleted), requirement status, data rows and dependencies. `blockers` lists why a real install would be refused. Requires packages.view.

params.name: file
params.description: The .utpkg file, base64 (or send multipart/form-data with a `file` field)

params.name: package_id
params.description: Instead of file: a package built in this workspace

params.name: values
params.description: { <requirement id>: { <field key>: value } } — e.g. { "connector:connectors:<id>": { "credentials.password": "…" } }. ${env:VAR} is substituted by the CLI

params.name: keep_incomplete
params.description: Install even when required values are missing: affected assets are installed disabled ("Needs configuration") until complete setup

params.name: adopt_by_name
params.description: First install: adopt existing assets with the same unique name

params.name: data
params.description: Per package data table id: merge (default), replace or skip its rows

params.name: keep_local_changes
params.description: Upgrade: keep assets changed in this workspace since the last install

params.name: source_label
params.description: Where the file came from (shown in the library)

endpoints.label: Install or upgrade a package (upgrade in place when it is installed already)
endpoints.description: Verifies checksum and signature (tampered packages are refused), applies the assets (each section also needs its own create / edit permission) and records the install. Missing required values fail the install unless keep_incomplete: affected assets are then disabled and dependent workflows cannot be activated until POST /package-installs/{id}/complete. Upgrades keep local requirement values. Requires packages.install.

params.description: Recorded in the package history as the channel (the CLI sends "cli")

endpoints.label: Uninstall: remove package-owned assets (dry_run lists them; locally changed assets and tables with rows are kept unless force / delete_data)
endpoints.description: The dry run lists every asset and what happens to it (delete / skip with the reason / gone), rows of data tables, unfinished runs of the package's workflows (`active_runs`) and `blockers`: missing delete permissions of a section, or runs in progress unless cancel_runs. Recorded in the package history. Requires packages.install.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: List what would be removed (plan, active runs, blockers)

params.name: force
params.description: Also remove assets changed in this workspace since install

params.name: delete_data
params.description: Also delete data tables that hold rows (the rows are lost)

params.name: cancel_runs
params.description: Cancel unfinished runs of the package's workflows first (needs workflows.activate); without it they block the uninstall

params.name: source
params.description: Recorded in the package history as the channel (the CLI sends "cli")

endpoints.label: Package history: every install, upgrade, reconfigure (complete setup) and uninstall, failed attempts included (newest first)
endpoints.description: Who, when, channel (UI / CLI / API / MCP), version from → to, signature status, counts, requirement changes and errors. Uninstalled packages keep their history. GET /package-events/{id} adds the full plan / diff that was applied. Requires packages.view.

params.name: package
params.description: Install id, package id (uid) or package slug

params.name: action
params.description: install, upgrade, reinstall, downgrade, reconfigure, uninstall (comma-separated)

params.name: until
params.description: Up to and including this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or timestamp

endpoints.label: One package history event with the full plan / diff that was applied (secrets masked)
endpoints.description: One package history event with the full plan / diff that was applied (secrets masked) Requires packages.view.

endpoints.label: List background jobs
endpoints.description: Jobs started by this credential's user (tenant keys: by this key), newest first. scope=tenant lists every job of the workspace (needs settings.edit).

params.name: status
params.description: Only these statuses: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled (comma-separated)

params.name: active
params.description: true: only queued or running jobs

endpoints.label: Get a background job (status, progress, result summary)
endpoints.description: Get a background job (status, progress, result summary)

endpoints.label: Cancel a queued or running job
endpoints.description: Queued jobs stop at once; running jobs stop at their next progress report (work already done is kept).

endpoints.label: Start a failed or cancelled job again
endpoints.description: Creates a new job with the same input, checked against the caller's current permissions.

endpoints.label: The JSON result of a finished job
endpoints.description: For async API requests: exactly the `data` the synchronous request would have returned. 409 while the job is not finished, 410 once expired.

endpoints.label: Download the result file of a finished job
endpoints.description: The file itself (Content-Disposition: attachment). Owner only; 409 while the job is not finished, 410 once expired. CLI: `usertasks jobs download <id>`.

endpoints.label: List events from the unified event stream (oldest first, cursor paged)
endpoints.description: Workflow, integration, agent, task, system, audit and security events, retained for 72 hours by default. Pass next_cursor as `after` to read the next page. Requires observability.view.

params.name: category
params.description: Categories (comma-separated): workflow, integration, agent, audit, security, task, system. audit and security also need settings.view

params.name: type
params.description: Event types or globs (comma-separated), e.g. workflow.* or *.failed

params.name: run_id
params.description: Only events of this workflow run

params.name: trace_id
params.description: Only events with this trace id

params.name: since
params.description: ISO timestamp or a duration back from now (30s, 15m, 1h, 2d, 1w)

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor: only events after this id (the previous next_cursor)

params.name: until
params.description: ISO timestamp or duration: only events at or before

endpoints.label: List log export destinations (credentials masked)
endpoints.description: List log export destinations (credentials masked) Requires observability.view.

endpoints.label: Create a log export destination (Splunk HEC, Datadog, OTLP/HTTP, webhook, syslog, Azure Monitor, Event Hubs, Cloud Logging, Pub/Sub, CloudWatch Logs)
endpoints.description: Needs settings.edit and observability.view (and settings.view when audit/security events can be exported). URLs are checked against the egress policy. Credentials are write-only (masked as __SECRET__). For webhook destinations without a signing_secret one is generated and returned once as `signing_secret`. Requires settings.edit.

params.name: type
params.description: Destination type: splunk_hec, datadog, otlp_http, webhook, syslog, azure_monitor, azure_event_hubs, gcp_logging, gcp_pubsub, aws_cloudwatch_logs

params.name: config
params.description: Type-specific settings: splunk_hec { url, index?, sourcetype?, source?, host?, verify_tls? }; datadog { site?, service?, tags? }; otlp_http { endpoint, resource_attributes? }; webhook { url }; syslog { host, port?, transport? (tls|tcp|udp), framing?, facility?, app_name?, hostname?, tls_servername? }; azure_monitor { endpoint, dcr_immutable_id, stream_name, auth?, tenant_id?, client_id?, cloud? }; azure_event_hubs { namespace, event_hub, auth? (sas|client_secret|managed_identity), sas_key_name?, tenant_id?, client_id?, cloud? }; gcp_logging { project_id, log_id?, resource_type?, labels?, auth? }; gcp_pubsub { project_id, topic, attributes?, ordering_key?, auth? }; aws_cloudwatch_logs { region, log_group_name, log_stream_name?, auto_create?, auth? (access_key|instance_role) }

params.name: credentials
params.description: Secrets: splunk_hec { token }; datadog { api_key }; otlp_http { headers? }; webhook { signing_secret?, headers? }; syslog { client_cert?, client_key? }; azure_monitor { client_secret? }; azure_event_hubs { sas_key? | client_secret? }; gcp_logging / gcp_pubsub { service_account_json? }; aws_cloudwatch_logs { access_key_id?, secret_access_key? }. Never returned: reads show __SECRET__, and __SECRET__ on update keeps the stored value

params.name: filters
params.description: { categories?, types? (globs), min_severity?, workflow_ids? }; default every event

params.name: start_from
params.description: now (default): only events from now on; retention_start: everything still retained

endpoints.description: Get a log export destination (credentials masked) Requires observability.view.

endpoints.label: Update a log export destination
endpoints.description: Credentials are write-only (masked as __SECRET__). For webhook destinations without a signing_secret one is generated and returned once as `signing_secret`. Requires settings.edit.

params.name: type
params.description: Cannot change; accepted so a fetched destination can be sent back

params.name: config
params.description: Merged over the stored config (null removes a key)

params.name: credentials
params.description: Merged over the stored credentials; __SECRET__ keeps a value, null removes it

endpoints.label: Delete a log export destination
endpoints.description: Delete a log export destination Requires settings.edit.

endpoints.label: Move a destination's cursor to now or to the start of retention
endpoints.description: Move a destination's cursor to now or to the start of retention Requires settings.edit.

params.name: from
params.description: now: skip everything not yet shipped; retention_start: re-send everything still retained
